headline: The wrong-version warning now stays up while you work.
notes: The amber "you're on an old version" banner used to disappear the moment you clicked anything in the Project panel — exactly when you were most likely to be looking at it. It now follows your timeline, whatever else is selected.
**Check for updates**, in the ☰ menu. The panel looks once a day on its own; this asks straight away.
Fixed: docked as a narrow strip, the three buttons sat far apart with small symbols. Tighter gutters, bigger icons.
Fixed: docked tall and narrow, the panel could stay in the compact strip instead of using the height it had.
